title: Repeated counter placement uses target two instead of target three (Incremental Growth / Incremental Blight)
body:
Incremental Growth and Incremental Blight announce three targets, but the third counter placement uses `Ref_TargetPermanent2` instead of `Ref_TargetPermanent3`.

Target two receives both the two-counter and three-counter placements; target three receives none. The third placement must apply three counters to target three.
